title: Miraculous Survival: Woman Credits Skims Bodysuit for Preventing Fatal Bleeding After Suffering Four Gunshot Wounds
htmlContent:
A woman's TikTok video has taken the internet by storm after she claimed that a Skims bodysuit, designed by Kim Kardashian, saved her life during a shooting incident. Angelina Wiley, the woman in question, shared her story in a video that quickly went viral, capturing the attention of millions of viewers.

In her TikTok video, Wiley recounted the terrifying events that took place on New Year's Day of 2023. She revealed that she had been shot four times while waiting for her Lyft to pick her up in Kansas City, Missouri. What makes her story even more remarkable is the fact that she was wearing a Skims shaping bodysuit underneath her dress at the time of the incident.

According to Wiley, the tightness of the Skims bodysuit played a crucial role in her survival. She claimed that it prevented her from bleeding out, essentially acting as body armor for women. In her video, she expressed her gratitude towards Kim Kardashian, the creator of Skims, and credited her with saving her life. Wiley said, "Call it fate or Jesus, but I'mma call it Kim."

The video quickly gained attention, not only from social media users but also from Kim Kardashian herself. Kardashian reportedly saw the video and reposted it on her Instagram Story, accompanied by the comment "wowww" and a prayer hands emoji. The endorsement from the fashion mogul and reality TV star further amplified the story, generating even more interest and speculation.

However, it appears that Wiley's Skims bodysuit is no longer in her possession. In a subsequent statement, she revealed that the detectives investigating the shooting incident have taken the garment as part of their investigation. Wiley expressed her disappointment, stating that she now has "0 Skims." It remains to be seen whether the bodysuit will have any impact on the investigation or if it will be returned to her.

While the incident has sparked a mix of reactions and discussions online, it's important to note that Wiley's claims about the Skims bodysuit should be taken with caution. The idea of a shapewear garment acting as body armor is not a scientifically proven concept. It's possible that the tightness of the bodysuit may have provided some compression and support, but its ability to prevent bleeding or significantly reduce the impact of gunshot wounds is highly unlikely.

Nevertheless, the story serves as a testament to the power of social media and how a personal experience can capture the attention of millions. Angelina Wiley's TikTok video, her claim of survival thanks to the Skims bodysuit, and Kim Kardashian's repost have all combined to create a viral moment that has become the topic of conversation across various platforms.

As the investigation into the shooting incident continues, it remains to be seen if any additional information or evidence will surface regarding the role of the Skims bodysuit. In the meantime, the story stands as a remarkable account that highlights the unpredictable ways in which social media can shape narratives and capture the attention of the world.
